I used film-crew for the shot plan and seedance-25-director for the prompts.

The teaser is called **"From Page to Screen."** The same hands that write a page also clap the slate. A line of ink becomes a stack of pages, then a shelf of scripts, then a film set, then a camera that starts rolling. It ends on black for the logo. That covers both halves of the studio: screenwriting and full production.

- **Style:** precise and dark (borrowed from Fincher's way of working, but no director is named in the prompts). One hard light from the left and pure black around it. Each frame has at most one red object, and two shots have none.
- **Format:** 6 shots, 30 s, 9:16. Each shot is its own Seedance 2.5 generation, and the shots are joined with hard cuts in the edit.

**Assumptions I made:**
- **No faces.** Only hands and silhouettes appear, so no reference images are needed.
- **Text, numbers and logo go on in the edit.** Your brand guide says the logo is never redrawn, and Seedance tends to misspell text. The logo comes from `maghakian_logo_light.png` and is placed over the black end frame.
- **Supers are in English,** and Armenian versions are ready in the edit table. Pick one language per post.
- **Music is added in the edit.** Seedance only produces the on-set sounds: pen, paper, clapper, camera.

**Shot plan**

| # | Time | Shot | Beat | Super |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0-4 s | Top-down extreme close-up: a fountain pen writes one line, then lifts | Hook | Every story starts on a page. |
| 2 | 4-9 s | Top-down close-up: pages pile up fast; a red triangle tab sticks out | Volume | 2,300+ episodes |
| 3 | 9-14 s | Camera slides left to right along a shelf of black scripts and stops on the red-tabbed one | Range | 48 projects |
| 4 | 14-20 s | Camera rises from a page on a stage floor to reveal a lit set: chair, cinema camera, crew silhouettes | Writing becomes production | From script… |
| 5 | 20-25 s | Low close-up: the same hand claps the slate; the camera's tally light turns red | "We shoot it" | …to screen. |
| 6 | 25-30 s | Push into the lens until the frame is pure black (from 27 s) | Sign-off | Logo + SCREENWRITING · FULL PRODUCTION + @maghakianscripts |

**What I couldn't run:** this session had no shell, so I didn't run the film-crew validator script, and the separate continuity check wasn't done either. I went through the validator's checklist by hand instead.

**Things to watch:**
- Seedance may draw fake letters on the pages, spines or slate. Pick the cleanest of the variants.
- The black at the end of shot 6 may flicker. If it does, cut to a black solid at 27 s in the edit.

**Session notes:** this folder isn't a git repo and had no NOTES.md. So I didn't pull at the start, and I couldn't commit or push at the end. I created `NOTES.md` with today's entry.

The full package (brief, department notes, cut plan, sound, storyboard, generation plan, review) is in `film-crew/maghakian-reels-teaser/`.

## FINAL

**Settings for all 6 shots:**
- Seedance 2.5 on Dreamina, Omni Reference, no files uploaded
- Ratio 9:16, 1080p if your plan offers it (otherwise 720p)
- Durations: 4 / 5 / 5 / 6 / 5 / 5 s
- Make 2-3 variants per shot, in order 1 → 6

**SHOT 1 (4 s)**
```text
No reference files; text-to-video.
Top-down extreme close-up of a fountain pen writing one line of handwriting on white paper at night: low-key, precise, monochrome.
[0-4s] Plain white bond paper with fine fibre texture lies on a matte graphite desk (#111111). From the very first frame a black fountain pen with a steel nib is already touching the paper at frame-left. A writer's hand, seen only from the wrist down (pale olive skin retaining real fine pores and skin texture, short clean unpolished nails, the cuff of a fine black merino knit sweater at the wrist, no rings, no watch), writes one fluid line of illegible cursive in glossy wet black ink from frame-left to frame-right. At 3.5 s the nib lifts cleanly off the paper and stops in the air; a tiny bead of ink catches the light. Camera: locked top-down, 100mm macro look, drifts very slowly to frame-right with the nib and stops when the nib lifts. Sound: close, crisp scratch of the nib on paper, one soft exhale, faint room tone. ➖ No readable letters or words, no face, no second hand, no ink splatter.
Global: pitch-black room; one hard cold-white desk lamp from high frame-left makes a tight pool of light and everything outside it falls to pure black (#000000). High contrast, shallow depth of field, clean digital image with fine grain, black, white and graphite only, no other colour in frame. Keep the upper third of the frame as clean dark negative space. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no background music.
```

**SHOT 2 (5 s)**
```text
No reference files; text-to-video.
Top-down close-up of a stack of white script pages growing fast on a graphite desk: low-key, precise, monochrome with one small red accent.
[0-5s] On a matte graphite desk (#111111) a neat stack of plain white bond paper pages sits in the centre of the light pool. From the first frame single sheets fall from above, out of frame, and land flat on top of the stack one after another, about three sheets per second, each landing with a soft slap and a small puff of air that lifts the edge of the sheet beneath; the stack visibly rises toward the camera. A small solid triangle of matte red paper (deep signal red, #D90429) sticks out from the right edge of the stack as a page tab. At 4.5 s the last sheet settles and everything is still. Camera: locked top-down, 50mm look, a slow push-in of about ten percent that follows the rising stack, then holds. Sound: rhythmic soft paper slaps speeding up, paper rustle, faint room tone. ➖ No printed or readable text on the pages, no hands, no pages sliding off the desk, no second red object.
Global: pitch-black room; one hard cold-white desk lamp from high frame-left makes a tight pool of light and everything outside it falls to pure black (#000000). High contrast, clean digital image with fine grain, black, white and graphite only; the single small red tab is the only colour in frame. Keep the upper third of the frame as clean dark negative space. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no background music.
```

**SHOT 3 (5 s)**
```text
No reference files; text-to-video.
Lateral tracking shot along a dark shelf of identical black-bound scripts, stopping on the one marked in red: low-key, precise, monochrome with one small red accent.
[0-5s] A long matte graphite shelf (#111111) holds a dense row of identical scripts bound in matte black covers, standing upright with their spines toward the camera, each spine with a small blank white label and no readable text. Hard light rakes along the spines from frame-left, catching their edges in thin white lines; the far end of the shelf falls to black. Camera: at the height of the spines, medium shot, 50mm look, already moving at the first frame, a smooth dolly from frame-left to frame-right at walking pace that eases to a stop at 4 s when one script with a small solid triangle of matte red paper (deep signal red, #D90429) sticking out of its top edge is exactly centred; it holds still to the end. Sound: soft low rumble of the dolly wheels, a faint creak of paper, room tone. ➖ No readable titles or letters, no people, no colourful covers, no second red object, no camera shake.
Global: pitch-black room; one hard cold-white light from high frame-left, everything outside its reach falls to pure black (#000000). High contrast, clean digital image with fine grain, black, white and graphite only; the single small red tab is the only colour in frame. Keep the upper third of the frame as clean dark negative space. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no background music.
```

**SHOT 4 (6 s)**
```text
No reference files; text-to-video.
The camera rises from a single script page on a dark soundstage floor to reveal an empty, lit film set: low-key, precise, monochrome.
[0-3s] Top-down close-up of one plain white script page lying flat on a black soundstage floor inside a sharp pool of hard white light; the page carries faint grey lines of illegible typed text. A slight draft lifts its corner once and lets it fall. Camera: locked top-down, 24mm look; at 2 s it begins to rise smoothly.
[3-6s] In one continuous motion the camera cranes up and tilts up, revealing the whole set: the page lies at the edge of the light pool; in the centre of the pool stands one empty wooden chair; at frame-right a black professional cinema camera with no brand logos stands on a dolly facing the chair, the small tally light on its top switched off; two crew members in black stand as dark silhouettes at the edge of the light, completely still. The camera stops at 5.5 s on a wide high-angle frame and holds. Sound: deep hollow soundstage room tone, one distant footstep, the faint hum of a light ballast. ➖ No readable text, no visible faces, nobody sitting in the chair, no coloured lights, no red anywhere in frame.
Global: a dark film soundstage, black floor, graphite walls (#111111) disappearing into pure black (#000000); one hard cold-white key light from high frame-left makes the only sharp pool of light. High contrast, clean digital image with fine grain, black, white and graphite only. Keep the upper third of the frame as clean dark negative space. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no background music.
```

**SHOT 5 (5 s)**
```text
No reference files; text-to-video.
Low-angle close-up of a black cinema camera on a dark soundstage as a clapperboard snaps and the camera starts rolling: low-key, precise, monochrome with one small red accent.
[0-5s] Close-up from a low angle on the left side of a black professional cinema camera body and lens with no brand logos, a small dark tally light on its top; behind it the set falls out of focus into black with one soft pool of white light. At 0.5 s a writer's hand, seen only from the wrist down (pale olive skin retaining real fine pores and skin texture, short clean unpolished nails, the cuff of a fine black merino knit sweater at the wrist, no rings, no watch), brings a plain matte black clapperboard with black-and-white diagonal stripes on its sticks and no writing on the slate into frame from the left, in front of the lens, snaps it shut with a sharp clack at 1.5 s, and pulls it out of frame to the left by 2.5 s. At 3 s the small tally light on top of the camera switches on and glows deep signal red (#D90429). Camera: a very slow, steady push-in toward the lens through the whole shot. Sound: the sharp wooden clack of the clapperboard at 1.5 s, a soft electronic click as the tally light turns on at 3 s, then the quiet whir of the camera running. ➖ No writing, numbers or chalk on the clapperboard, no face, no second red light, no camera shake.
Global: a dark film soundstage, everything outside the light falls to pure black (#000000); one hard cold-white key light from high frame-left. High contrast, shallow depth of field, clean digital image with fine grain, black, white and graphite (#111111) only; the single red tally light is the only colour in frame. Keep the upper third of the frame as clean dark negative space. Pure video, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no logos, no background music.
```

**SHOT 6 (5 s)**
```text
No reference files; text-to-video.
Extreme close-up push straight into the front glass of a cinema lens until the frame turns pure black: low-key, precise, monochrome with one tiny red accent.
[0-5s] The front of a black cinema camera lens fills the frame, centred; its glass elements reflect the hard white key light as thin concentric rings, and a single tiny red reflection of the tally light (deep signal red, #D90429) glints at the upper edge of the glass. Sound: the quiet whir of the running camera continues, then fades to total silence by 3 s. ➖ No brand text or numbers on the lens, no flares or light leaks during the black hold, no fade to grey, nothing appears in the black.
Global: a dark film soundstage; one hard cold-white key light from high frame-left; everything outside the light is pure black (#000000).
```
